quests.hint: Open to discussion and change.
quests.explanation: 'Negotiable' describes a price or term that can be discussed. The opposite is 'non-negotiable'.
quests.textToSpeak: The asking price isn't fixed; it's ___, so go ahead and make an offer.
quests.correctAnswer: The asking price isn't fixed; it's negotiable, so go ahead and make an offer.
quests.contextClue: Making an offer only makes sense if the price can change.

quests.hint: Something you agree to give up in order to reach a deal.
quests.explanation: A 'concession' is something you give in a negotiation. 'Make a concession' is the typical phrase.
quests.textToSpeak: We can make one ___: a longer delivery time, but the price stays the same.
quests.correctAnswer: We can make one concession: a longer delivery time, but the price stays the same.
quests.contextClue: One thing is given while the price stays fixed.

quests.hint: The rules set out in an agreement.
quests.explanation: 'Terms and conditions' are the rules of a contract. 'On good terms' means in a good relationship.
quests.textToSpeak: Before you sign, read the ___ and conditions carefully.
quests.correctAnswer: Before you sign, read the terms and conditions carefully.
quests.contextClue: It is something to read before signing.

quests.hint: Sold more tickets than there are seats.
quests.explanation: 'Overbooked' means more reservations were accepted than can be handled. Airlines may ask volunteers to take another flight.
quests.textToSpeak: The flight was ___, so some passengers were offered money to take a later one.
quests.correctAnswer: The flight was overbooked, so some passengers were offered money to take a later one.
quests.contextClue: Offering money for a later flight signals too many passengers.

quests.hint: Left somewhere without a way to continue or leave.
quests.explanation: 'Stranded' means unable to leave a place, often because transport has stopped.
quests.textToSpeak: We were ___ at the airport overnight after all flights were cancelled.
quests.correctAnswer: We were stranded at the airport overnight after all flights were cancelled.
quests.contextClue: Cancelled flights left the travellers waiting overnight.

quests.hint: A second flight or train you transfer to.
quests.explanation: 'Miss a connection' means fail to catch the next transport after a delay. 'Connecting flight' is related.
quests.textToSpeak: Our first flight landed late, so we missed our ___ and waited six hours for the next.
quests.correctAnswer: Our first flight landed late, so we missed our connection and waited six hours for the next.
quests.contextClue: Landing late explains missing the next flight.

quests.hint: A detailed plan of a trip with times and places.
quests.explanation: An 'itinerary' lists where you will be and when during a trip.
quests.textToSpeak: According to our ___, we land at nine and reach the hotel by eleven.
quests.correctAnswer: According to our itinerary, we land at nine and reach the hotel by eleven.
quests.contextClue: Times for landing and reaching the hotel are listed.

quests.hint: A first payment that secures something.
quests.explanation: A 'deposit' is part of the payment made in advance. The rest is paid later.
quests.textToSpeak: You need to pay a ___ to secure the booking; the rest is due on arrival.
quests.correctAnswer: You need to pay a deposit to secure the booking; the rest is due on arrival.
quests.contextClue: The rest is due on arrival, so some was paid first.

quests.hint: Arrange a new reservation after a change.
quests.explanation: 'Rebook' means make a new reservation, typically after a cancellation or delay.
quests.textToSpeak: The airline offered to ___ us on a later flight at no extra cost.
quests.correctAnswer: The airline offered to rebook us on a later flight at no extra cost.
quests.contextClue: The airline offers a later flight.

quests.hint: Decide which things are most important and do them first.
quests.explanation: 'Prioritise' (US 'prioritize') means put tasks in order of importance.
quests.textToSpeak: With so many tasks, we need to ___ and handle the urgent ones first.
quests.correctAnswer: With so many tasks, we need to prioritise and handle the urgent ones first.
quests.contextClue: Many tasks and urgency call for ordering.

quests.hint: A narrow point where progress slows down.
quests.explanation: A 'bottleneck' is the point in a process that slows everything else.
quests.textToSpeak: The approval process is the real ___; everything waits for one person to sign.
quests.correctAnswer: The approval process is the real bottleneck; everything waits for one person to sign.
quests.contextClue: Everything waits for one signature.

quests.hint: A temporary way to avoid a problem you can't fix properly.
quests.explanation: A 'workaround' avoids a problem without solving it permanently.
quests.textToSpeak: There's no perfect fix yet, but I found a ___ that keeps things running.
quests.correctAnswer: There's no perfect fix yet, but I found a workaround that keeps things running.
quests.contextClue: No perfect fix, but something keeps things working.

quests.hint: The part of a plant underground; in this phrase it means the origin.
quests.explanation: 'Root cause' means the original reason a problem happens. Fixing symptoms doesn't remove the root cause.
quests.textToSpeak: To fix the issue permanently, we need to find the ___ cause.
quests.correctAnswer: To fix the issue permanently, we need to find the root cause.
quests.contextClue: A permanent fix needs the origin of the problem.

quests.hint: An important stage or achievement in a project.
quests.explanation: A 'milestone' marks significant progress in a project or in life.
quests.textToSpeak: Finishing the prototype was a major ___ for the whole team.
quests.correctAnswer: Finishing the prototype was a major milestone for the whole team.
quests.contextClue: Finishing the prototype is a key stage.

quests.hint: A problem that delays progress.
quests.explanation: A 'setback' is a difficulty that slows progress. 'Suffer a setback' is common.
quests.textToSpeak: The delay was a ___, but we're still confident we'll finish on time.
quests.correctAnswer: The delay was a setback, but we're still confident we'll finish on time.
quests.contextClue: The delay is a problem, but confidence remains.

quests.hint: The advantages of something.
quests.explanation: 'Pros and cons' means advantages and disadvantages of a choice.
quests.textToSpeak: Let's list the ___ and cons of each option before we decide.
quests.correctAnswer: Let's list the pros and cons of each option before we decide.
quests.contextClue: The mention of cons points to the opposite side.

quests.hint: A difficult choice between two options.
quests.explanation: A 'dilemma' is a situation where you must choose between two difficult options.
quests.textToSpeak: I'm in a real ___: the job pays well, but it means moving away from my family.
quests.correctAnswer: I'm in a real dilemma: the job pays well, but it means moving away from my family.
quests.contextClue: Pay versus family is a hard choice.

quests.hint: Understanding something after it has happened.
quests.explanation: 'In hindsight' means looking back on a past event with later knowledge.
quests.textToSpeak: In ___, I should have asked more questions before signing.
quests.correctAnswer: In hindsight, I should have asked more questions before signing.
quests.contextClue: The speaker is looking back at an earlier decision.

quests.hint: Helpful and intended to improve.
quests.explanation: 'Constructive criticism' includes suggestions for improvement.
quests.textToSpeak: I welcome ___ criticism, as long as it comes with suggestions for improvement.
quests.correctAnswer: I welcome constructive criticism, as long as it comes with suggestions for improvement.
quests.contextClue: Suggestions for improvement define the type.

quests.hint: The ability to act without being told.
quests.explanation: 'Take the initiative' means act first without being asked.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody asked her to; she took the ___ and organised the whole event herself.
quests.correctAnswer: Nobody asked her to; she took the initiative and organised the whole event herself.
quests.contextClue: Nobody asked her, and she organised everything.

quests.hint: The time by which work must be done.
quests.explanation: A 'deadline' is the latest time by which something must be done. We 'meet' or 'miss' a deadline, and a 'tight deadline' leaves little time.
quests.textToSpeak: We missed the ___ for submitting the application by just one day.
quests.correctAnswer: We missed the deadline for submitting the application by just one day.
quests.contextClue: Missing by one day shows there was a fixed cut-off time.

quests.hint: A feeling of strain between people.
quests.explanation: 'Tension' is a feeling of strain between people. 'There was tension in the room' is common.
quests.textToSpeak: There was a lot of ___ in the office after the layoffs were announced.
quests.correctAnswer: There was a lot of tension in the office after the layoffs were announced.
quests.contextClue: Layoffs created strain at work.

quests.hint: Help two sides reach agreement as a neutral person.
quests.explanation: 'Mediate between' means help opposing sides settle a disagreement. The noun is 'mediator'.
quests.textToSpeak: A neutral manager was asked to ___ between the two departments.
quests.correctAnswer: A neutral manager was asked to mediate between the two departments.
quests.contextClue: A neutral manager sits between two departments.

quests.hint: General agreement among a group.
quests.explanation: A 'consensus' is a general agreement reached after discussion.
quests.textToSpeak: After a long discussion, we finally reached a ___ that everyone could accept.
quests.correctAnswer: After a long discussion, we finally reached a consensus that everyone could accept.
quests.contextClue: A long discussion ended in something acceptable to all.

quests.hint: Agreed by everyone.
quests.explanation: 'Unanimous' means everyone agrees: 'a unanimous vote'.
quests.textToSpeak: The vote was ___; every single member supported the plan.
quests.correctAnswer: The vote was unanimous; every single member supported the plan.
quests.contextClue: Every single member supported it.

quests.hint: Needing attention soon.
quests.explanation: 'Pressing' means urgent: 'a pressing matter'.
quests.textToSpeak: Let's deal with the more ___ matters first and leave the rest for next week.
quests.correctAnswer: Let's deal with the more pressing matters first and leave the rest for next week.
quests.contextClue: The others can wait until next week.

quests.hint: Make arrangements to meet someone's needs.
quests.explanation: 'Accommodate' means provide for someone's needs. It is also used for providing space.
quests.textToSpeak: We'll do our best to ___ your dietary requirements.
quests.correctAnswer: We'll do our best to accommodate your dietary requirements.
quests.contextClue: Dietary requirements need to be provided for.

quests.hint: Your stomach; in this phrase it means an instinct.
quests.explanation: A 'gut feeling' is an instinct without clear reasons.
quests.textToSpeak: My ___ feeling says we should wait, though I can't explain exactly why.
quests.correctAnswer: My gut feeling says we should wait, though I can't explain exactly why.
quests.contextClue: The speaker can't explain the reason.

quests.hint: Understand something wrongly.
quests.explanation: 'Misinterpret' means understand incorrectly. The prefix 'mis-' often means wrongly.
quests.textToSpeak: Please don't ___ my silence as disagreement; I'm just thinking.
quests.correctAnswer: Please don't misinterpret my silence as disagreement; I'm just thinking.
quests.contextClue: Silence may be taken the wrong way.

quests.hint: Shared by both sides.
quests.explanation: 'The feeling is mutual' means both people feel the same way.
quests.textToSpeak: The feeling is ___; I don't like him, and he doesn't like me either.
quests.correctAnswer: The feeling is mutual; I don't like him, and he doesn't like me either.
quests.contextClue: Both people share the same negative feeling.
